response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with most recent roles centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang; while they have brief C++ exposure from 2014–2015, there is no evidence of modern C++/STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or cloud-based industrial platform development required for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience with diverse technologies and open-source contributions
Demonstrated expertise in event-driven architectures and distributed systems
Proven ability to mentor, teach, and document technical concepts effectively
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development in the last 9+ years
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) and IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus)
No demonstrated experience with on-premises industrial automation platforms or cloud-native industrial solutions
